name: Magic Bento
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; no upstream source was read, and the GSAP dependency is replaced by a CSS grid plus one rAF-batched pointer handler that writes custom properties.

radius.description: Radius of each card's light, in px.

proximity.description: Distance outside a card, in px, at which its glow starts.

spotlight.description: A soft light that follows the pointer across the whole grid.

touch.description: Track touch pointers too (touch has no hover).

a11y: The grid never reorders cards (no dense packing), so the visual order follows DOM order, which is the reading and tab order.
The glow and spotlight are pseudo-elements with no content, so nothing extra is announced and card text keeps its own contrast.
Keyboard focus on a card (for example a card that is a link) lights it from its centre and shows a :focus-visible outline, matching the pointer state.
Reduced motion stops pointer tracking, the hover lift and every transition; forced-colors mode drops the glow and draws a CanvasText border.
